name: Ten Symbols of Longevity
source:
In the year 2103, one day you move to the Oriental-inspired technological city of "Shinrok." Shinrok is not just an ordinary city but a special place where Eastern gods known as "Shinseon" coexist with humans.
.
Exploring the basement of your new home, you stumble upon a folding screen depicting the Ten symbols of longevity. Much to your surprise, the screen opens, revealing unfamiliar Shinseon entities? As if that weren't enough, you find yourself cursed upon opening the screen... To break the curse, you must cooperate with the "Shinseon of the Ten symbols."
.
Amidst conflicts and love, amidst countless stories, what choices will you make?

[from [url=https://bulhwa.itch.io/ten-symbols-of-longevity]itch.io[/url]]
